name: WhatsApp
description: Read your WhatsApp chats and groups, search them, and send a message you approved
author: flock

requires.description: Link WhatsApp to Flock's browser with a code on your phone
requires.rationale: WhatsApp has no API for personal accounts: WhatsApp Web, linked as one of your devices, is how the agent reads and sends for you.

list-chats.reason: Opens WhatsApp Web and waits for it to load the chats (up to a minute after a while away), then reads the list.

read-chat.reason: Opens WhatsApp Web, waits for the chats (up to a minute), finds the chat (by the list, else WhatsApp's search), reads its last messages and downloads up to 5 of their PDFs (up to 20 seconds each).

search.reason: Opens WhatsApp Web, waits for the chats (up to a minute), then types the search and reads the results.

send-message.reason: Opens WhatsApp Web, waits for the chats (up to a minute), opens the chat, types the message, sends it and checks it shows.

networkEndpoints.purpose: WhatsApp Web: the chat list, chats, search and sending
